full_prompt_en: The image is a square graphic painting in which a frontal face is assembled from interlocking geometric shapes. The face fills a black rectangular panel set inside a narrow off-white margin. A thick black vertical line splits the center, though the two halves are deliberately unequal. On the left, a large blue eye sits beneath a heavy black eyebrow, with short white marks forming the lower lashes. On the right, an eye with a yellow iris is contained by concentric black, white, and orange curves. A tall yellow block descends through the forehead and becomes an angular nose. A rounded gray spiral shapes the other side of the nose and cheek. The mouth near the lower center is divided into red and yellow semicircles by a black horizontal bar. Circular yellow accents near the ears echo the eyes. Around the face, black-and-white bars, red checkerboard squares, blue slashes, and narrow orange stripes make a busy decorative frame. Despite these many pieces, the central face remains instantly recognizable. Color is flat and opaque, with crisp boundaries and no atmospheric shading. Black occupies a large share of the composition and holds the red, yellow, blue, white, and gray shapes in place. The different patterns have distinct rhythms: repeated vertical bars, squares, circles, and curling arcs. The apparent light comes from color contrast rather than an external source; no cast shadow or realistic depth is present. Slight variations in printed or painted surface may be visible, but the effect is chiefly hard-edged and deliberate. The frontal composition is compact and symmetrical enough to read as a face, yet playful asymmetry prevents it from becoming a simple mask. The result is bold, decorative, and rhythmic, with visual energy carried by interlocked shape and carefully limited color.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形图形绘画，正面人脸由相互嵌合的几何形状组装而成。脸填满一个黑色矩形画面，外面留窄米白边。粗黑竖线分隔中央，不过两半故意不等。左侧，一只蓝眼位于厚黑眉下，短白线构成下睫毛。右侧，黄虹膜被同心的黑、白、橙弧线围住。高大的黄色块从额头垂下，成为棱角分明的鼻。圆润灰色螺旋组成鼻与颊的另一侧。下方中央的嘴被一道黑横杠分成红和黄半圆。耳旁黄色圆点与眼睛呼应。脸四周，黑白条、红色棋盘格、蓝色斜条与窄橙竖线组成繁忙的装饰框。虽然元素众多，中央的脸仍一眼可辨。颜色平涂且不透明，边界清脆，没有空气明暗。黑色占画面很大比重，将红、黄、蓝、白和灰色形状固定住。不同图案各有节奏：重复竖条、方格、圆与回旋弧线。亮度来自色彩对比，而非外部光源；画中没有投影或写实纵深。印刷或绘画表面或有少许变化，但主要效果仍是硬边且经过精心安排。正面构图足够对称而能读作人脸，活泼的不对称又让它不只是简单面具。成品大胆、装饰性强且有节奏，以嵌合形状和严格限制的色彩承载视觉活力。
style_prompt_en: Hard-edged geometric painting reduces recognizable forms to interlocking circles, bars, wedges, checkerboards, and thick contour lines. Black serves as a structural field, locking opaque red, yellow, blue, white, and gray pieces into a compact grid. Flat color carries brightness without external light or cast shadow. Repeated stripes and blocks create separate visual beats around a bold central shape. Symmetry supplies immediate legibility, while differing details on each side keep the design active. Edges are crisp and graphic, with only slight material variation inside the color fields. The overall effect is playful, confident, and decorative, like a carefully balanced painted print.
style_prompt_zh: 硬边几何绘画把可辨形体化为相互嵌合的圆、条、楔、棋盘格与厚轮廓。黑色成为结构底域，把不透明的红、黄、蓝、白和灰色部件锁进紧凑网格。平色自身承担亮度，没有外部光源或投影。重复的条纹和方格在醒目中心形状四周产生各自节拍。对称使图案立即易读，两侧不同细节又保持活跃。边缘清脆而图形化，色域内部只有轻微材料变化。整体活泼、笃定且富装饰性，像经过精心平衡的绘制印刷品。
theme_en: A geometric face assembled from bold black lines and primary-color shapes
theme_zh: 以粗黑线和原色几何形拼成的一张脸
name: Fernand Leger
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
